recommendation: Keep the commit. The named removed profiles no longer have active core StructureDefinition/profile source or OID rows, and provenance-relevant-history remains in core with the applied guidance changes. Do not duplicate the existing FHIR-48829 combined-branch audit commit.
issue_request: FHIR-48828 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for the FHIR-core profile list. It resolved to remove actualgroup, example-composition, groupdefinition, and shareabletestscript, and to retain provenance-relevant-history with informative status, revised guidance text, an outdented Request relevant-history heading, and no separate mustSupport notes section.

additional_context: FHIR-I minutes on 2025-06-09 corroborate the Persuasive with Modification vote and refer to the Jira resolution for detailed profile dispositions. FHIR-48829 is the related ProvenanceRelevantHistory retention decision and already has an Issue-Reconcile-Key audit commit on the combined branch, so it was not republished here. source/fhir.ini keeps StructureDefinition active, making its example list and StructureDefinition example source build-scope inputs.
